composition: Native vertical 1024x1536 phone wallpaper. Design the full tall canvas with convincing depth, elegant leading lines and a strongly resolved focal scene in the middle and lower areas. Let scale, texture, atmosphere and beautiful lighting create the impact. Preserve clarity instead of filling every area with ornament.
creative_direction: Show one pale-pink lotus near a deep-teal water surface, with two broad leaves forming a low protective arc. Copper evening light grazes the nearest leaf veins while the flower remains softly luminous. Keep ripples minimal and reflections broad. A smooth distant haze opens above the bloom, creating a calm balance between rich foreground material and empty atmosphere. Vertical 1024x1536. Reserve the upper twenty percent as naturally quiet negative space, keeping detail lower in the composition. Original peaceful image, no text, branding, or watermark.
